answerVersions.rawOpenAIAnswer:
Cancellation cost insurance covers you for unforeseen events occurring before your departure that make it impossible for you to set off on your journey. Insured events include:

- Illness, accident or death
- Loss of employment
- Breakdown/delay of public transport
- Breakdown of the vehicle or taxi you are travelling in
- Damage to your property at home
- Incidents occurring en route to or after arrival at your destination (e.g. strikes, terrorism, volcanic eruption or other natural events)
- Grounding, strike or bankruptcy of your airline or tour operator

The benefits include covering the cost if you have to cancel, abort, or extend your trip, as well as additional travel expenses in the event of delayed departure and cancellation costs, including administration fees. 

Source: [assistance-brochure.pdf, page 4]
